subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should issue #38364 remain open as the umbrella for Control UI reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split and close it in favor of #88032/#90745 and #87561?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI protocol shape, agent runtime context, channel reply semantics, and final fallback delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract or tracker shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep #38364 open while the structured reply metadata path and durable final-fallback delivery contract are accepted or replaced.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this only after maintainers confirm the reply-metadata issue or PR and the final-fallback issue fully own the two halves.

options.title: Narrow To Markdown Quote UI
options.body: Treat the merged quote UI as sufficient for Control UI replies, intentionally dropping the structured metadata ask from this issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep #38364 open while the structured reply metadata path and durable final-fallback delivery contract are accepted or replaced.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest observed history across the reply prompt envelope, webchat runtime-context, and embedded runtime boundaries involved in the decision.
